editorial:
Imagine having to play house with someone you can't stand, all while your heart is breaking for your child. You get to see a couple who have completely fallen apart, but they decide to fake a happy marriage because their daughter is losing her memory. It is a real tear-jerker that feels very honest. You will feel the tension between the parents as they try to remember why they ever liked each other in the first place, all while trying to keep a smile on their faces for their girl. The vibe is heavy and sad, but there are sweet moments that make you root for them to actually fix things.

The acting is the best part here because the emotions feel real and not forced. While the story moves a bit slow in the middle, the payoff at the end is totally worth the wait. If you love stories about family and second chances, you need to see this.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the daughter finally forgets who her parents are entirely. Instead of falling apart, the couple stops pretending and decides to actually love each other for real. They realize that while their daughter may not remember them, they can still provide her with a loving home. The movie ends with them holding hands, choosing to start a new life together based on truth rather than a lie.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves emotional family stories and dramas that make you cry.
